measurements.name: ALOUD Biological Lifestyle & Health Questionnaire

measurements.name: SRL-Practices Scale
measurements.description: Measures students' perception of engagement in self-regulated learning strategies in online and distance learning contexts. Part of the SRL Profile and Self-Diagnostic Instrument (SRL-PSD; Hadwin et al., 2022).

items.group: Stem: "Over the last two weeks, when I did academic work, I..."
list: Task Understanding (5 items) — e.g., 'thought about relevant information and resources'
Task Value (3 items) — e.g., 'reflected on why this work is important'
Goal Management (5 items) — e.g., 'made goals to learn, understand or remember'
Motivation Appraisal (3 items) — e.g., 'assessed if I think I can do it'
Time Management (3 items) — e.g., 'created a timeline or a schedule'
Metacognitive Monitoring (3 items) — e.g., 'asked myself if I understand the material'
Metacognitive Adaptation (6 items) — e.g., 'switched to a different strategy or approach'
Social Engagement (3 items) — e.g., 'helped fellow students'

measurements.name: SRL Self-Efficacy Scale

items.group: Stem: "In the next two weeks, I can..."
list: e.g., 'manage my goals'
(Additional items cover planning, monitoring, adapting, time management, help-seeking — 12 items total)
